items.title: FAA lifts nationwide ground stop that blocked takeoffs for hours
items.author: Richard Lawler
items.content:
Takeoffs from airports throughout the US largely stopped on Friday after the FAA issued a national ground stop at 3:44PM ET "due to extraordinary circumstances and for reasons of safety."

More than four hours after the stop was issued, officials announced it was lifted at 8:15PM ET and that flights will resume. It's unclear how many flights will be able to take off and when, as they now face problems of overloaded airports and flight crews that have run out of time to operate the planes, meaning many people will be stuck where they are for the time being and more flights will be delayed or canceled.

items.title: Amazon has a plan to index the world’s online shopping data
items.author: Stevie Bonifield
items.content: Amazon has plans to build a vault of data on every product sold anywhere on the internet, even products Amazon doesn't sell, and make the information available through its own site, according to . The project, called the "World Product Graph," is meant to make it less likely that shoppers leave Amazon to do their product research on Reddit or Google, and make it more likely shoppers end up at Amazon even if they're searching for a product sold elsewhere. items.title: ChatGPT Wallet lets OpenAI’s Dots agents make purchases for you
items.author: Stevie Bonifield
items.content: After adding a card to the wallet, your Dots agents can use it to buy things in response to your prompts, but they'll check in with you each time before checking out. OpenAI's support page says every purchase with ChatGPT Wallet requires a security check with biometric verification like Face ID or a fingerprint scan.

items.title: CMF’s milk carton-shaped Bluetooth speaker is down to a new low price
items.author: Brad Bourque
items.content:
Bluetooth speakers are often boring boxes in plain colors, but not this one! As part of Nothing’s ongoing early Black Friday promo, you can grab its unique, milk carton-shaped from Amazon and Nothing for just $39. That’s a solid $20 discount and the lowest price we’ve seen on Nothing’s newfangled wireless speaker, which hit the market about a month ago.

The CMF Speaker S is the smaller of the two recently-released models — the larger Series M is also on sale at Amazon for $79 ($30 off) — and sports a 45mm driver with two passive radiators to help with low-end frequencies. It can run for up to 18 hours on a single charge and carries an IP68 rating for water and dust resistance. Despite its carefree aesthetic, it also supports stereo pairing with a second Seris S speaker, Bluetooth 6, fast pairing via multiple methods (including NFC and Google Fast Pair), and audio over USB-C.

In addition to their great sound and compact footprint, both the Speaker S and Speaker M feature removable faceplates and multifunction front knobs. Not only can you swap them out to customize the colors, but CMF plans to share STL files so anyone with a 3D printer can create their own attachments and looks.

items.title: Here’s how you can save on your GTA VI preorder ahead of launch
items.author: Brad Bourque
items.content:
The long-awaited launch of is around the corner, happening next Friday, November 19th. While discounts on the game itself will be rare for some time, there’s a clever workaround to save you a few bucks on your digital copy. We found discounts on gift cards for both Sony PlayStation and Microsoft Xbox Series S/X owners to help shave some dollars off your upcoming trip to Vice City. You can pick up a $75 Sony gift card for $69 at Newegg when you use coupon code at checkout, and Costco members can pick up four $25 Sony gift cards for $89.99.

Meanwhile, Xbox owners can pick up a $90 Xbox gift card for $80 at Newegg by using the coupon code at checkout. The standard edition is $79.99, while the ultimate edition is $99.99, so you can either spend an extra $10 out of pocket for the upgrade, or buy the standard version and set any leftover credit aside for use later on.

While neither offer amounts to huge savings, it’s an opportunity to save on a major video game release that likely won’t get any sort of discount this year. Preloading has already begun on both consoles, and the game will unlock at midnight local time on November 19th.

items.title: You can adjust the position of the trackball on Keychron’s new wireless mouse
items.author: Andrew Liszewski
items.content: The Nape Pro was Keychron's first trackball device that was introduced at CES 2026 with a slim and compact design allowing it to be positioned right up against a keyboard. The company's new T1 HE instead looks more like other trackball mice already available from companies like Logitech and Kensington with a 34mm ball positioned on the side to improve ergonomics. But since hands and fingers come in various sizes, the T1 HE allows the position of its trackball to be fine-tuned with minor positional adjustments so it rests squarely under your thumb without any reaching.

items.title: The smallest version of Camp Snap’s retro digital camcorder fits on your keychain
items.author: Andrew Liszewski
items.content: Last week, Camp Snap launched a miniaturized version of its screen-free CS-8 video camera that was half the size of the original with a smaller grip designed to be easier for kids to hold. But it turns out the company wasn't done shrinking its hardware. Camp Snap's new CS-8 Micro is even smaller than the CS-8 Mini. It's around three inches long and weighs just 1.5 ounces so you can hang it from your keys and, like its larger predecessors, it can capture video using one of five built-in filters.

items.title: The new Apple TV has a YouTube problem
items.author: Stevie Bonifield
items.content:
People who received the brand new Apple TV 4k today saw some strange error messages as soon as they opened the YouTube app. As the first units arrived, the app was initially only showing a black screen with a QR code and an error message saying "YouTube is not yet available on this device." In some cases the app was functional, but had a transparent red bar stuck at the bottom of the screen saying, "YouTube app is approved for device testing only and not for production use."

Installing the new tvOS 27.2 update and rebooting wasn't enough to resolve the issue for 's Tom Warren, he also had to uninstall and reinstall the app.

items.title: Microsoft’s massive Outlook outage might be over
items.author: Jess Weatherbed
items.content:
Service is recovering for Microsoft Outlook and 365 after an almost two-day outage impacting millions of users around the world. While some apps and features are still running in a degraded state on Friday morning, some people (including staffers) reported that access to their emails had been restored, though the flow of Outlook mail might be delayed.

Just before noon on Friday, Microsoft said it's seeing "broad recovery," and that the problem "was a technical issue not related to cyber or AI / agents."
